artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G - Event Immutability & State Recovery Evidence

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Truncated market_state slicing (market_state[t] contains bars strictly <= t).
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Every decision slice is verified to contain zero future dates. SMA and momentum indicators are calculated exclusively from backward-looking rolling windows.

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Orders emitted at session T close cannot execute at T close; they are queued and execute at open T+1.
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Verified across ReplayEngine and synthetic runner: all fills take open price of T+1.

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Scenario 17 exercises delivery of identical duplicate bars with same timestamp.
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Duplicate events are identified and discarded idempotently by timestamp deduplication guard, preventing duplicate trades or double counting.

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Scenario 16 exercises injection of negative price bar (open -10, close -10).
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Sanitization guard drops non-positive price observations; portfolio preserves previous valid close; zero crashes or accounting corruptions.

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Scenario 15 serializes PortfolioState (cash, positions, cost basis, dividends) to JSON, restarts process, and mark-to-markets resumed state.
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Resumed portfolio state matches pre-interruption NAV to 1e-9 relative tolerance ($0.00 residual).

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Scenario 19 simulates an amended corporate action (split ratio revision from 2:1 to 4:1).
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Historical entries are not silently overwritten; revision is applied as a distinct transaction event preserving historical auditability.

immutability_and_recovery_audits.verification_method: Audited all runtime modules for datetime.now(), live sockets, or background network calls.
immutability_and_recovery_audits.evidence: Clock is 100% driven by explicit bar timestamp strings. Zero network calls occur during replay.
